tests.name: a chat session, a task try and a run worker of a child repository list under its workspace inside the product repos folder
tests.why: grouped() places chat, try, orchestrator and worker rows under the child repo inside the product-repos workspace; title quotes the MUST's cases

tests.name: a session whose origin repository was deleted is still listed under the folder, and its workspace is marked missing only when every session's origin is gone
tests.why: deleted-origin case: still listed and marked missing; title quotes the case

tests.name: 100 child repositories, each with a try, give 100 workspaces under the folder in name order and no stray
tests.why: the 100-child-repos case with worktree tries grouped by origin

tests.name: a standalone repository's task try groups under that repository's workspace, as its chat sessions do, by key or by origin
tests.why: standalone repo's try joins its chat sessions' workspace; title quotes the MUST

tests.name: workspaces in the nav > groups by repository, falls back to the folder, nests forks under their root, and places cloud sessions
tests.why: unchanged base test of how chat sessions group, the behaviour worktree sessions must match

tests.name: the session panel's Reaches line names the switched-on special repos, with each path on hover, and says Only this repository when none is on
tests.why: only test of the Reaches line (src/ui/special.tsx); browser only

tests.name: a regroup keeps each row's id and star, and a plain folder session keeps its own folder's key whatever its origin
tests.why: a starred worktree row keeps its object, id and star under its new group; does not check folds, hand order or keys

tests.name: task tries and run workers list under their repository inside the product repos workspace, with a deleted origin marked, stars kept and every row reachable by Tab
tests.why: browser check of stars kept and keyboard reach of nested rows (Tab, not arrows); also covers MUST 1 visually

tests: tests/unit/worktree-grouping.test.ts::a session whose origin repository was deleted is still listed under the folder, and its workspace is marked missing only when every session's origin is gone
findings.note: The mapped test asserts the marker is dropped when a healthy clone shares the key, enshrining the gap; a test expecting a per-session marker would fail on head (partial: the right expectation, not a base run, is what exposes it).

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::the session panel's Reaches line names the switched-on special repos, with each path on hover, and says Only this repository when none is on
findings.note: Folding the special-repos section hides the line; the browser test never folds it, and no fail-on-base check would expose this.

tests: tests/unit/worktree-grouping.test.ts::a regroup keeps each row's id and star, and a plain folder session keeps its own folder's key whatever its origin
tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::task tries and run workers list under their repository inside the product repos workspace, with a deleted origin marked, stars kept and every row reachable by Tab
findings.note: Tests cover the grouping helper but not consumers such as the tab title and scoped file search; a coverage gap that a fail-on-base check does not measure.

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::task tries and run workers list under their repository inside the product repos workspace, with a deleted origin marked, stars kept and every row reachable by Tab
tests/unit/worktree-grouping.test.ts::a regroup keeps each row's id and star, and a plain folder session keeps its own folder's key whatever its origin
findings.note: The acceptance tests check proxies (fixture without hidden tries, Tab instead of arrows, identity without an actual regroup); they fail on base yet still pass on head, so a fail-on-base gate would accept them.

notes: Head includes s2's commits, so actions, server, task-loop and the New run e2e tests belong to s2. MUST 3 has no Vitest test (Playwright only). Other MUST 1 unit cases in worktree-grouping.test.ts (80-character name, failed repository key, fork of a try) and the host test 'the host marks a session whose origin folder is gone, and only that one' also fit. MUST 4's folds and hand order have no direct test at this head.
